_comment: Hand-maintained spec-row to bench/record coverage map (issue #50). Evidence-neutral: it never changes a spec value. Checked by .github/scripts/check_evidence_formats.py against the table in spec/target-spec.md. Verdicts: no_bench, placeholder_circuit, device_level_only, method_absent, measured_pass, measured_fail. A measured_* verdict may not cite a record whose Claim line says placeholder or device-level. A row moves off its current verdict only via a later record that says why.

rows.blocked_by: DR-0001 (still proposed); ITU-level edge check recorded in spec/literature-citations-2026-10-10.md Part 1 (source evidence only); target jurisdiction/service, sub-band scope and band selection undecided; passive feasibility gate open

rows.bound_corner: `hbt_wcs`, 125 °C (device noise rises with T; worst self-heating)
worst process × temp × supply combination; out-of-band as well as in-band
`hbt_typ`, nominal supply/temperature (to be confirmed — linearity's corner dependence is a bench finding, not an assumption)
rows.note: Nominal-corner (hbt_typ, 27 C, 2.5 V) two-tone IIP3 of the ideal-matching placeholder at 17.9/18.0, 19.4/19.5 and 20.9/21.0 GHz: -13.29, -13.88 and -11.77 dBm (converged under timestep halving and window doubling; fitted over -56..-44 dBm per tone, extrapolated ~30 dB). Meets the unchanged -15 dBm target at that corner on that placeholder only; not measured compliance (ideal matching, one corner, draft band, row 17 limits break from about -43 dBm per tone).

Input P1dB is NOT determined within the DUT operating limits: the instantaneous Q2 V_CE exceeds the 1.4 V row-17 limit from -36 dBm (low/mid) / -34 dBm (high) single-tone available power, well below the -25 dBm target, so only a lower bound (> -38 / -38 / -36 dBm) is recorded. The limit-ignoring reference (labelled NOT A RESULT in the record) crosses 1 dB at -16.1 and -17.5 dBm (low, mid) and above -16 dBm (high). Target unchanged; placeholder circuit, one corner.
